# Chapter 1 local lesson videos

These MP4 files are played by the local lesson reader. They retain their original creators and source attribution; see media-manifest.json for the original public pages and checksums. No third-party content license is granted by the website code. The files use H.264 video and AAC audio at 720p. Kirchhoff’s audio was compressed to 96 kbps; its video stream is unchanged.

The local server serves byte ranges for seeking. MP4 files are not copied into the browser’s application cache; keep this folder with the website. Use the supplied serve.py when running a portable copy.
